title: A Blue Hour for the Silence
author: Cyrus Eriksen
blurb: Isandro Dunmore, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
